richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tiruppur

c: Tiruppur runs on knitwear, and its garment units employ large numbers of workers who often live in hostels or quarters near the factory. An open gym on a factory campus gives them free exercise in the little time they have. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tiruppur for garment and textile campuses, schools, colleges, parks and residential layouts. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,030 km away.

Export units are also used to buyer audits that look at worker welfare, and a well-kept outdoor gym is a visible facility. We suggest machines that many people can use in short shifts, send a layout drawing and install with our team or a dealer in south India. The equipment is sent to Tamil Nadu by road.

items.q: Can a garment factory set up an outdoor gym for workers?
items.a: Yes. A small set of multi-user machines near the canteen or hostel works well. Share the space and number of workers, and we will plan the layout.

items.q: Do the machines need a trainer or power supply?
items.a: Neither. Each machine works on the user's own body weight and simple movement, so workers can use them safely on their own in short breaks.

items.q: How do we keep lint and dust out of the machines?
items.a: Install them on a paved or rubber-floored base, sweep it daily and wipe the moving parts weekly. Our after-sales team can advise your maintenance staff.
